in_latin.name: Neriahel
in_latin.meaning: Lumen Domini - Lumen = lux, Dominus = Deus
in_latin.long_meaning: Neriahel - Nomen a Ioanne Chrysostomo, qui nominavit Ioannem, qui erat servus Domini, quia erat lumen Domini in tenebris.
